text:
rachael: quick FYI — we just saw a spike of 413s from a partner integration hitting the embeddings endpoint. looks like mixed-dim arrays in one request. console shows a 12x error rate increase for route /v1/embeds/prod-vec during the 10m window
ben: ugh. is this the classic mixed-dims + big payload? any sample payloads?
rachael: partner sent 3 items: dims [768, 1024, 768] in same batch, total payload ~1.4MB. runtime rejected it with 413. stacktrace from runtime attached in logs.
igor: yep, current router fast-fails mixed-dim batches early. we return a plain 413 body. not great UX though — client just retries blindly.
mira: can we return guidance in the error? e.g. header X-Embed-Suggest-Split or a JSON like {suggestion: "split into 3 requests: 2x768,1x1024", reason: "mixed dims"}?
ben: +1. also include preferred batch sizes and an example curl. reduces partner ops.
igor: technically ok, but we must be careful not to leak internal routing topology. suggestion: structured error with only_hint fields: suggested_splits (list of sizes in dims), max_bytes, retry_after_seconds. no node ids or shard hints.
rachael: prototype error payload (for UX):
```json
{
  "error": "input_shape_mismatch",
  "message": "Mixed embedding dims in single request",
  "hint": {
    "suggested_split_dims": ["768","1024","768"],
    "max_batch_bytes": 500000,
    "reason": "split-by-dim"
  }
}
```
mira: looks good. console changes: we should add a tiny banner on the route doc and surface a counter metric `embed.mixed_dim.fastfail` with tenant tag. ops wants a dashboard tile.
ben: agree. also need to update SDKs to surface that error as a typed exception so users can programmatically fallback to split logic.
igor: runtime change is minimal: enrich the 413 response for clients above api-version 2. we can gate via feature flag `embeds:dim_hint_v1`. default off for 1 week canary.
rachael: rollout plan idea: canary to internal tenants + 3 partner orgs, monitor `embed.mixed_dim.fastfail`, `embed.split_suggestions_accepted` (client followed suggestion), latency delta. If suggestion acceptance > 30% and no regressions we flip global.
mira: for console UX I want two widgets: 1) time-series of mixed-dim fastfails and 2) gauge for suggestion-accepted ratio. also add drilldown to example payloads (sanitized) and recent tenants.
ben: telemetry impl note: `suggestion_issued=true/false` on the 413 span, and `suggestion_followed=true` if subsequent request from same trace uses suggested dims header. can we correlate?
igor: yes if clients send `X-Trace-Id` or we stitch by tenant+short-hash. privacy: no payloads in telemetry. just unit counts and anonymized size buckets.
rachael: any objections to including estimated_cost_hint? telling them estimated token/embedding cost increase if they split. might be useful but could be sensitive.
mira: i'd avoid exact $ numbers. a qualitative hint like "expected latency: +20%" or "expected per-item compute: unchanged" is okay.
ben: SDK change checklist: (1) detect error code `input_shape_mismatch`, (2) parse hint.suggested_split_dims, (3) auto-retry split if opt-in flag in client. default: not auto-retry. docs sample.
igor: runtime checklist: (a) add hint generation, (b) feature-flag gate, (c) emit telemetry metrics, (d) set header `X-Embed-Dim-Hint-Version: v1` when present.
rachael: ops/alerting: create alert if mixed-dim fastfail rate > 200/min or suggestion_accepted < 5% after 24h. also manual rollback playbook.
mira: UX phrasing for console banner: "Requests with mixed embedding dimensions will receive a structured guidance error. See SDKs for helpers." short and actionable.
ben: small nit — make sure language across runtime/SDK/docs uses same names: `input_shape_mismatch`, `suggested_split_dims`, `max_batch_bytes`. consistency prevents confusion.
igor: agree. i'll open a PR with runtime changes and draft the error contract. can we ship the contract as spec in the console (API reference) and link SDK PRs?
rachael: yes. timeline: PRs this week, canary next Tue, monitor 48h, then ramp. i'll coordinate with partner success for the partner canary list.
console-bot: deploy-bot: canary feature flag `embeds:dim_hint_v1` created. ID ff-emb-dim-1723. scheduled rollout window: 2026-04-12 16:00 UTC -> 2026-04-14 16:00 UTC.
ben: awesome. one last question: do we include this hint for oversize-but-uniform-dim batches (single dim but > max batch bytes) as well? or separate error `payload_too_large`?
igor: separate error for size-only cases. we can reuse `max_batch_bytes` in both, but error code will be `payload_too_large` vs `input_shape_mismatch`. different handling in SDK.
mira: ok. i'll wire up dashboard PR and copy deck snippets for the partner onboarding guide.
rachael: thanks y'all. i'll post the rollout playbook and link PRs here once open. :thumbsup:
